specs.notes: define_component! ExtentManager, provides IExtentManager, receptacles metadata_device + logger
validates sector_size>0, slab_size%sector_size, max_extent_size<=slab_size, region_count pow2, checkpoint region fit
superblock at LBA 0 with params + CRC32
reads/validates superblock, recovers active checkpoint, rebuilds state
sector-aligned slot, WriteHandle w/ offset, not visible pre-publish
publish writes key; FREE_KEY frees slot + returns Ok silently
abort/drop frees slot
remove sets FREE_KEY, OffsetNotFound, deferred free via pending_frees
get_extents/for_each_extent skip FREE_KEY slots
dense keys: Vec<u64> per slab, no separate index
FREE_KEY = u64::MAX
BTreeMap<u64,Slab>, range(..=offset).next_back()
serialize slabs+key vectors, CRC32, write inactive, flip superblock
skip when no region dirty
Condvar coalescing, single in-flight writer
code default 30s correct; interface doc + README still say 'five minutes'; FR-016 asks these be corrected but they remain stale
active copy first, inactive fallback
rebuild bitmap from key vectors (non-FREE_KEY -> allocated)
per-region buddy allocator
bitmap allocator with rover
SizeClassManager HashMap<element_size,Vec<start_offset>>
key & (regions.len()-1)
parking_lot::RwLock per region
Send+Sync by composition, not enforced (matches FR wording)
deferred free until post-checkpoint
get_instance_id from superblock
set_checkpoint_interval(Option<Duration>); None -> wait indefinitely
set_metadata_ns_id on concrete struct, not in trait
set_dma_alloc
feature semantics inverted vs spec (enabled => flush compiled IN, not out) AND BlockDeviceClient has no flush() method => compile error when feature enabled; no flush in format() path
used_bytes = buddy total_usable - total_free (slab granularity)
returns usable size (data_disk_size - data_start_offset), not total data_disk_size; differs under shared-device (metadata_region_size>0)
WriteHandle in interfaces crate, RAII two-phase
FaultConfig (fail_after_n_writes, fail_all_writes) behind testing feature; no read faults (matches spec)
metadata_region_size default 128 MiB; caps metadata area, computes data_start_offset; 0 => data_start_offset=0
metadata_base_lba applied to metadata I/O; data_base_lba stored+returned but never applied to any internal I/O (component has no data-device I/O path)
set_post_checkpoint_hook fired once synchronously after superblock update before return
lifecycle correctness via integration tests
checkpoint+recovery round-trip reconstructed from key vectors
dual-copy fallback
per-region locks, 8+ thread tests
100M-extent scale is explicit 'not yet verified by benchmark' architectural target (tasks.md Open item); consistent with spec wording
at most 2 sequential checkpoint I/O, never parallel
